name: homelab
description: Keep a Linux home machine healthy: one-pass health check (OS image, apps, firmware, disks, SMART, mounts, services, containers, tailnet) with a daily notifying timer, guided system updates, and an Android TV kept current over adb (Stremio, SmartTube, Tailscale, Key Mapper remote remaps) with a weekly update timer, and a debloated, unattended Windows 11 install USB (local account, apps removed during Setup, verified silent app installs at first logon).
